messages.subject: Help with the iteminfo function
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to figure out how the iteminfo function works exactly by reproducing it. Specifically, I want to reproduce the information matrix (multidim_matrix = TRUE).
I am looking at the iteminfo functions and underlying functions such as ItemInfo2 and DerivTheta, I think I am almost there but I am not getting the same output as the iteminfo function.

Below my example with one graded response item with five categories and four traits (theta's). I am trying to get the info for the first trait only.

th_seq<-c(0,0,0,0)
D<-1
a1<-1.481 
a2=a3=a4=0
a_ap=c(1.481 , 0  ,0  ,0)
d1<-4.394
d2<-2.124
d3<-.01
d4<--3.139

pi1=1-(1/ (1+exp(-D*(a_ap%*%th_seq+d1))) )
pi2=(1/ (1+exp(-D*(a_ap%*%th_seq+d1))) ) - (1/ (1+exp(-D*(a_ap%*%th_seq+d2))) )
pi3=(1/ (1+exp(-D*(a_ap%*%th_seq+d2))) ) - (1/ (1+exp(-D*(a_ap%*%th_seq+d3))) )
pi4=(1/ (1+exp(-D*(a_ap%*%th_seq+d3))) ) - (1/ (1+exp(-D*(a_ap%*%th_seq+d4))) )
pi5=(1/ (1+exp(-D*(a_ap%*%th_seq+d4))) )

W11a=a1*pi1*(1-pi1)
W11b=a1*pi2*(1-pi2)
W11c=a1*pi3*(1-pi3)
W11d=a1*pi4*(1-pi4)
W11e=a1*pi5*(1-pi5)

grad=vector('list', 5)
for(i in seq_len(5))
  grad[[i]] <- matrix(0, 1, 4)
grad[[1]][,1]=W11a-W11b
grad[[2]][,1]=W11b-W11c
grad[[3]][,1]=W11c-W11d
grad[[4]][,1]=W11d-W11e

P=matrix(c(pi1,pi2,pi3,pi4,pi5),1,5)

info <- matrix(0, 4, 4)
for (i in seq_len(5)) info <- info + outer(as.numeric(grad[[i]]), 
                                           as.numeric(grad[[i]]))/P[, i]

info

         [,1]         [,2] [,3] [,4]
[1,] 1.720016    0    0    0
[2,] 0.000000    0    0    0
[3,] 0.000000    0    0    0
[4,] 0.000000    0    0    0

iteminfo(extract.item(cmod,1),cbind(0,0,0,0),degrees = c(0,0,0,0),multidim_matrix = TRUE) gives:

          [,1]          [,2] [,3] [,4]
[1,] 0.6148583    0    0    0
[2,] 0.0000000    0    0    0
[3,] 0.0000000    0    0    0
[4,] 0.0000000    0    0    0

I figured that the degrees do not really matter given that all a's other than a1 are zero (simple structure), so the information matrix will always look like this, with a non zero value on the upper left diagonal and all other values at zero.

I hope someone can help me! Also, this is my first post on this forum so I hope I am sticking to the conventions/rules. :)

Best,

Dirk

messages.subject: Re: Help with the iteminfo function
parts:
I'd recommend downloading the source code of mirt from Github, and putting a browser() somewhere where you are most interested in. Then, using R's debugging interface, walk-though the code until you find where your approach doesn't match what mirt is doing. HTH.

Phil
